PULSE-001.title: Overall health
PULSE-001.what: Shows the overall health of this Moment as a single score and status.
PULSE-001.why: Gives you an instant read on whether things are progressing well without scanning every widget.

how.default: A 0–100 health score refreshed from your recent activity, money, and Moment signals.
how.LIFE_OPERATIONS: Your Ops Index (0–100) comes from your latest Life Operations health score, refreshed from recovery, pressure, mood, attention, and money activity. It stays blank until enough signal activity exists.
how.FUTURE_BUILDING: Your Momentum score (0–100) comes from your Future Building momentum signal—learning, execution, milestones, and confidence—updated as you log progress.
how.LIFESTYLE: Your Vitality score (0–100) blends health, energy, and routine signals from Lifestyle activity. Status bands like Thriving or Building follow that score.
how.RELATIONSHIPS: Your Bond score (0–100) reflects relationship health from connection, trust, and support signals, updated as you log relationship activity.

PULSE-002.title: Core parameters
PULSE-002.what: Shows the key dimensions that contribute to the overall health score.
PULSE-002.why: Helps you see why the overall score is high or low.

how.default: Each parameter is a 0–100 dimension score from your Moment metrics and recent activity.
how.LIFE_OPERATIONS: Pressure, Recovery, Discipline, and Attention come from your latest metric snapshots. Attention is shown as the inverse of cognitive load.
how.FUTURE_BUILDING: Learning, execution, growth, clarity, and confidence axes come from Future Building signals and related activity counts.
how.LIFESTYLE: Joy, fulfillment, vitality, and exploration axes come from social, wellbeing, energy, and environment signals.
how.RELATIONSHIPS: The radar axes—connection, trust, communication, support, presence, and growth—come from relationship metric scores and recent connection activity.

PULSE-003.title: Financial summary
PULSE-003.what: Summarises the current financial position for this Moment.
PULSE-003.why: Gives immediate money context without opening full transaction history.

how.default: Totals come from money events logged this month for this Moment—spending, and budget or income where available.
how.LIFE_OPERATIONS: Spent is the sum of this month’s debits. Budget and remaining come from credits and capacity; utilization is spent ÷ budget.
how.FUTURE_BUILDING: Investment and category totals sum debits logged against Future Building money events.
how.LIFESTYLE: Lifestyle spend sums debits for this Moment this period, grouped by category where shown.
how.RELATIONSHIPS: Spend totals sum relationship-related debits for this Moment.

PULSE-004.title: Recent activity
PULSE-004.what: Lists the latest activities logged in this Moment.
PULSE-004.why: Helps you see what recently changed.

how.default: Pulled from your activity timeline in newest-first order, including quick-add and money events linked to this Moment.

PULSE-006.title: Financial intelligence
PULSE-006.what: Shows how spending is distributed across categories for this Moment.
PULSE-006.why: Helps you judge where money is going relative to this Moment’s purpose—not just the total spent.

how.default: Category shares are this month’s debits grouped by expense category, shown as amounts and percentages of total spend.

PULSE-007.title: Current trend
PULSE-007.what: Shows the recent direction of this Moment over about the last 30 days.
PULSE-007.why: Helps you spot improving or declining momentum beyond a single day.

how.default: Built from recent timeline activity rolled into a short trend series. Sparse history may show an empty or partial chart.

PULSE-008.title: Current state snapshot
PULSE-008.what: Quick gauges of important operational indicators right now.
PULSE-008.why: Lets you grasp the Moment’s state without deep analysis.

how.default: Gauge values are the latest metric or signal percents for this Moment (for example stability, recovery, momentum, or connection).

PULSE-009.title: Primary recommendation
PULSE-009.what: Suggests the highest-impact next action for this Moment.
PULSE-009.why: Helps you prioritise what matters most right now.

how.default: Chosen from your current opportunity card—priority and guidance based on recent scores, pressure/recovery, and profile signals.

PULSE-010.title: Recommended actions
PULSE-010.what: Lists practical actions that can improve this Moment.
PULSE-010.why: Turns insights into steps you can take immediately.

how.default: Quick-add and action shortcuts for this Moment. Completing them feeds the same timeline and scores that refresh Pulse.

PULSE-011.title: Pulse insights
PULSE-011.what: Highlights observations from recent activity and scores.
PULSE-011.why: Explains why recent changes matter in plain language.

how.default: Insight text comes from your latest runtime summary and activity volume. Confidence rises as more timeline events accumulate.

MOMENT-001.title: Journey score
MOMENT-001.what: Shows overall progress and health of this Moment as a journey score.
MOMENT-001.why: Gives an instant sense of how successfully the journey is progressing.

how.default: A 0–100 journey score from this Moment’s primary health score, with a status band from that value.
how.LIFE_OPERATIONS: Journey score mirrors your Ops Index / primary Life Operations score, with phases and insight from the latest runtime summary.
how.FUTURE_BUILDING: Journey score mirrors Future Momentum from learning and execution signals.
how.LIFESTYLE: Journey score mirrors Lifestyle Vitality from health, energy, and routine signals.
how.RELATIONSHIPS: Journey score mirrors Bond / relationship health from connection and trust signals.

MOMENT-002.title: Journey summary
MOMENT-002.what: Summarises the current state of the journey—phases, insight, and key counts.
MOMENT-002.why: Shows scale and status without opening every section.

how.default: Phases, insight text, and counts (days active, events, experiences) come from the journey hero built from runtime and timeline data.

MOMENT-003.title: Journey activity
MOMENT-003.what: Shows recent activities completed during this journey.
MOMENT-003.why: Helps you see what has happened lately on the journey.

how.default: Recent journey timeline items from your activity feed for this Moment.

MOMENT-004.title: Journey timeline
MOMENT-004.what: Shows major events across the lifecycle of this Moment.
MOMENT-004.why: Helps you see how the journey has evolved over time.

how.default: Chronological journey events from the latest activity timeline entries for this Moment.

MOMENT-005.title: Financial progress
MOMENT-005.what: Shows how money for this Moment has moved over time.
MOMENT-005.why: Helps you compare financial movement across the journey.

how.default: A multi-month spend series from debits logged to this Moment, grouped by month and highlighting peak months or categories.

MOMENT-008.title: Best moments
MOMENT-008.what: Highlights the most meaningful experiences from this journey.
MOMENT-008.why: Encourages you to revisit memorable milestones.

how.default: Drawn from saved Moment highlights when available; otherwise from recent meaningful timeline activity.

MOMENT-TP.title: Turning points
MOMENT-TP.what: Marks notable shifts that changed the direction of this journey.
MOMENT-TP.why: Helps you recognise pivots that matter more than day-to-day noise.

how.default: From saved turning-point records for this Moment when available.

MEMORY-001.title: Identity snapshot
MEMORY-001.what: Shows the behavioural identity emerging from your accumulated experiences.
MEMORY-001.why: Helps you see the pattern of who you are becoming—not just isolated activities.

how.default: Identity title, description, and confidence come from your latest identity snapshot for this Moment, updated when behaviour shifts meaningfully.

MEMORY-002.title: Core pattern
MEMORY-002.what: Shows the dominant behavioural dimensions shaping long-term behaviour.
MEMORY-002.why: Helps you understand the drivers that consistently influence decisions.

how.default: Top behavioural dimensions with scores and interpretations from pattern analysis for this Moment.

MEMORY-003.title: Best drivers
MEMORY-003.what: Highlights the strongest behavioural contributors supporting growth.

how.default: Highest-ranked drivers from behavioural driver rankings for this Moment.

MEMORY-004.title: Lowest drivers
MEMORY-004.what: Highlights weaker behavioural contributors that need attention.
MEMORY-004.why: Surfaces improvement opportunities without focusing on single failures.

how.default: Lowest-ranked drivers from the same driver rankings used for best drivers.

MEMORY-005.title: Behaviour patterns
MEMORY-005.what: Shows recurring behavioural patterns from your history.
MEMORY-005.why: Helps you spot consistency, improvement, and cycles.

how.default: Pattern cards from memory pattern snapshots, with confidence based on supporting activity.

MEMORY-007.title: Emotional DNA
MEMORY-007.what: Shows long-term emotional tendencies such as joy, stress, confidence, and connection.
MEMORY-007.why: Helps you understand the emotional patterns under your experiences.

how.default: Emotional dimension scores and explanations from your emotional DNA snapshot for this Moment.

MEMORY-008.title: Evolution timeline
MEMORY-008.what: Shows how behavioural maturity has evolved over time.
MEMORY-008.why: Helps you recognise long-term growth, not only short-term wins.

how.default: Chronological stages from evolution snapshots, with the current stage highlighted.

MEMORY-009.title: AI interpretation
MEMORY-009.what: Shows a high-confidence interpretation of the story emerging from your memories.
MEMORY-009.why: Gives a meaningful read on the deeper pattern in your experiences.

how.default: Interpretation text from memory recommendations or the Moment’s narrative summary.

MEMORY-010.title: Growth edge
MEMORY-010.what: Highlights the behavioural area with the greatest opportunity to improve next.
MEMORY-010.why: Points you toward the next stage of development.

how.default: Priority growth area and guidance from the next growth-edge recommendation for this Moment.

MEMORY-ROI.title: Highest return behaviours
MEMORY-ROI.what: Shows behaviours that return the most value for the effort you invest.
MEMORY-ROI.why: Helps you double down on what works best over time.

how.default: Ranked return behaviours or ROI bars from driver rankings and Moment-specific return analysis.

LIFE-001.title: Life score
LIFE-001.what: Shows your overall Life Score across Personal Moments.
LIFE-001.why: Gives a holistic view of life progress beyond any single Moment.

how.default: A 0–100 life health score aggregated from your active Personal Moment scores and life intelligence signals.

LIFE-002.title: Life balance
LIFE-002.what: Visualises balance across core life dimensions.
LIFE-002.why: Helps you see which areas are strong and which need attention.

how.default: Dimension scores for Life Operations, Future Building, Lifestyle, and Relationships from the latest life balance model.

LIFE-003.title: Life journey
LIFE-003.what: Shows how your overall life story has progressed over time.
LIFE-003.why: Helps you see long-term growth rather than daily noise.

how.default: Chronological life journey events from your life journey timeline.

LIFE-004.title: Emotional trend
LIFE-004.what: Shows how emotional tone has moved recently.
LIFE-004.why: Helps you notice shifts in mood and connection across weeks.

how.default: A short emotional trend series derived from connection, fulfillment, stress, and momentum signals.

LIFE-005.title: Dominant emotion
LIFE-005.what: Highlights the emotion most present in your recent life picture.
LIFE-005.why: Makes the emotional centre of your life easy to see at a glance.

how.default: Taken from your dominant emotion and emotional DNA breakdown in the life projection.

LIFE-006.title: Connections
LIFE-006.what: Summarises important life connections and relationships.
LIFE-006.why: Keeps people and bonds visible in your overall life view.

how.default: From saved life connection records linked to your Personal life view.

LIFE-007.title: Drift alert
LIFE-007.what: Flags when part of life is drifting off course.
LIFE-007.why: Surfaces early warnings so you can course-correct.

how.default: Shown when a drift alert exists in your life snapshots; otherwise hidden.

LIFE-008.title: Leverage
LIFE-008.what: Points to the area where a small change can unlock more life progress.
LIFE-008.why: Focuses effort where it compounds most.

how.default: From your identified leverage area in the life aggregate when available.

LIFE-009.title: Happiness drivers
LIFE-009.what: Shows what is contributing most to happiness right now.
LIFE-009.why: Reinforces the sources of wellbeing worth protecting.

how.default: Driver labels and return indicators from the life happiness projection.

LIFE-010.title: Life intelligence
LIFE-010.what: Shares a deeper observation about your current life pattern.
LIFE-010.why: Goes beyond operational metrics into meaningful guidance.

how.default: From your life intelligence summary or the top life recommendation.

LIFE-011.title: Monthly changes
LIFE-011.what: Summarises what shifted in life this month versus last.

how.default: From monthly change snapshot rows in your life projection.

LIFE-012.title: Start with one action
LIFE-012.what: Recommends a single high-impact next step for life balance.
LIFE-012.why: Prevents overwhelm by prioritising one meaningful action.

how.default: Quick actions curated for the life tab; completing them feeds the Moments that refresh your Life Score.
